capabilities.title: sameElement query
limitations: Requires supported array-of-struct fields and native elementFilter; it is not a general nested struct or map model.

capabilities.title: Fuzzy query
limitations: The reduced userInput/userQuery grammar does not accept full Vespa fuzzy syntax; use the typed query path.

capabilities.title: Prefix, suffix, and substring queries
limitations: These typed helpers are not part of the reduced textual userInput/userQuery grammar.

capabilities.title: Alternatives and equivalence queries
limitations: alternatives currently accepts term children only; more general alternatives are rejected.

capabilities.title: Nearest-neighbor vector search
limitations: The proven slice uses dense tensors and does not expose the full Vespa HNSW tuning surface.

capabilities.title: Geo-location and bounding-box queries
limitations: Geo matching is delegated to Vespa and is not implemented in Rust; verified bounding-box edges are inclusive.

capabilities.title: Predicate queries
limitations: Only the supported signed-integer range representation and documented predicate expression shapes are lowered.

capabilities.title: Weighted-set, dot-product, weak-and, and WAND queries
limitations: Only the currently supported typed annotations are exposed; unknown controls are rejected rather than dropped.

capabilities.title: userInput and userQuery text parsing
limitations: The parser intentionally supports a reduced grammar and rejects full Vespa escaping, boosts, range syntax, parser modes, and unsupported composites.

capabilities.title: Textual filter expressions
limitations: The filter expression language is a deliberate subset and is parsed and bound before entering canonical IR.

capabilities.title: Document summaries and stored-field projection
limitations: Vespa capability: grouped summary hits carry the selected docsum payload and remain beneath their owning group. Search Kernel limitation: the native seam currently forwards only grouped hit IDs and the adapter creates default/empty Hit values. User-visible impact: summary aggregation does not yet provide promised docsum fields and is not an executable public semantic capability. Reason/status: the native summary generator and typed grouped-hit payload are not implemented; blocked pending a faithful Vespa-backed result seam.

capabilities.title: Tensor feature and result readback
limitations: Tensor decoding is a higher-layer capability and is not implied by the opaque Vespa feature container.

capabilities.title: Structured grouping and faceting
limitations: Parallel grouping branches are not representable by the current linear native grouping plan.

capabilities.title: Grouping expressions and functions
limitations: Vespa capability: grouping supports the full expression/function family accepted by the grouping parser. Search Kernel limitation: the embedded native adapter currently supports attributes, literals, arithmetic, aggregation references, and the verified function subset only; Member, MapLookup, and Bucket remain rejected. User-visible impact: valid portable requests using those forms fail with a structured unsupported error. Reason/status: the current linear ABI has no typed constructors for those Vespa expression nodes; arithmetic/literal/function lowering is implemented but needs dedicated real-engine acceptance coverage.

capabilities.title: Grouping aggregations
limitations: The executable expression subset is documented by the native adapter; unsupported forms fail before execution.

capabilities.title: Summary aggregation
limitations: Vespa capability: summary() collects grouped hits using the surrounding max/default-hit policy and the requested summary class. Search Kernel limitation: finite max propagation is now retained where the linear plan has a grouping max, but grouped docsum payloads do not cross the native ABI. User-visible impact: callers cannot receive faithful summary fields from grouped Hit children. Reason/status: native summary generation and typed grouped-hit/docsum transfer remain unfinished; status is blocked, not a passing implementation.

capabilities.title: Grouping continuations
limitations: Vespa capability: grouping requests and responses carry opaque continuation tokens for paged group lists. Search Kernel limitation: tokens are rejected before native execution and are not represented in GroupingPlan or GroupingResult. User-visible impact: grouping pagination cannot be requested or resumed through V2. Reason/status: the current linear native ABI has no typed continuation input/output seam; implementation remains deferred.

capabilities.title: Raw grouping source
limitations: Raw grouping text requires a parser and normalization step before it can enter canonical IR.

capabilities.title: Document insert, upsert, patch, delete, and get
Arithmetic document updates
limitations: Arithmetic update nodes are represented in the portable contract but are not yet proven through the complete native product path.

capabilities.title: Conditional and matched-element updates
limitations: The portable update model represents conditional forms, but the public ergonomic and native execution paths are not complete.

capabilities.title: Tensor modify updates
limitations: Tensor modify operations are represented but not exposed as a complete ergonomic and verified product capability.

capabilities.title: Dense tensor document values
limitations: Sparse and mixed tensors remain unsupported in the current document and query-input paths.

capabilities.title: YQL query source
limitations: Only the existing low-level parser subset is supported; full Vespa YQL grammar, query profiles, and search chains are outside the wrapper.

capabilities.title: Analyzed text and WeakAnd queries
limitations: text(...) is plain analyzed text with Vespa's default WeakAnd semantics; it is not a phrase.

capabilities.title: Native in-term queries
limitations: String and integer values use Vespa's native InTerm node rather than an OR of equality terms.

capabilities.title: NonEmpty query wrapper
limitations: NonEmpty validates its lowered child and rejects statically empty boolean operators; it does not reproduce every parser-generated empty marker.

capabilities.title: Labeled query rank properties
limitations: Labels are allocated by the adapter and exported as internal vespa.label.* rank properties; callers must not provide those properties.

capabilities.title: Array-of-struct document fields
limitations: Member queries are relative to the parent element and do not form a general nested struct or map model.

capabilities.title: Position fields and derived geo attributes
limitations: The native adapter publishes Vespa-compatible derived zcurve data; Search Kernel does not implement geo matching independently.

capabilities.title: Match-feature and summary-feature readback
limitations: Match features cross the Vespa boundary as doubles or borrowed opaque data; tensor decoding is tracked separately.

capabilities.title: Recursive grouping result trees
limitations: The implemented plan exposes recursive groups, keys, aggregation values, and the canonical root, not Vespa's complete result-tree surface.

capabilities.title: Coverage, timeout, and issue metadata
limitations: Deterministic acceptance relies on real match-phase degradation; the frozen verifier does not fabricate a Vespa issue.

capabilities.title: Embedded single-node Vespa scope
limitations: Distributed routing, configuration services, schema deployment, federation, and other container-level Vespa facilities are outside this wrapper.
